verdict.rationale: Zulip is a team chat product, so operating it with natural-language commands is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no first-party natural-language command interface or AI assistant. The interactive bot framework is a developer building block for constructing such a capability, and search uses structured operators such as channel: and has:image rather than natural language. Neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
